8. GitBar

Tagline: Every pull request, one menubar. GitHub, GitLab & Azure
Description: GitBar is the macOS menubar app for pull requests. Connect GitHub, GitLab (cloud or self-hosted), and Azure DevOps across any number of accounts, and every PR you care about is one click away. See what’s yours, what’s waiting on your review, and what’s happening across your team. Status badges show approved, draft, conflicts, and checks at a glance. A live PR count lives in your menubar. Built with React Native for macOS. Free on the Mac App Store.

Tagline: The World’s First AI Newspaper Archive
